summary: Agent crews pilot protocol (#1353): paired single-agent vs crew runs on plate and DentalCoach, fixed 30% win threshold and 12-point cap, task mix including lifecycle work, ledger recording fields from #1352, stop rules and report format.
migration_impact: Documentation only. Teams running the #1338 pilot should follow the new protocol; no code or workflow changes.
migration_guidance: 1. Read docs/design/agent-crews-pilot-protocol.md before scheduling pilot runs.
2. Record spend with gh plate ledger --record-spend and attribute runs with gh plate costs --run-cost; never invent token or cost values.
3. On DentalCoach use paired-arm comparison only; do not claim a merged-PR historical baseline.
agent_notes: Closes design scope for #1353. Win metric is all-in cost per accepted outcome with escaped defects no worse; ~20 pairs are directional; ~30-76 pairs needed for a strong 30% cost claim.
